newsitem.title: USA: Deal struck to fund Orange County courts - report.
newsitem.headline: Deal struck to fund Orange County courts - report.

text.p: Orange County, Calif., supervisors and judges are close to resolving a $13.9 million court funding dispute, according to a published report on Tuesday.
Under the tentative deal, the courts would agree to slash their request for immediate funding from $13.9 million to $6 million or less, the Los Angeles Times reported.
The remainder of the funds -- $8 million to $10 million -- would be allocated over several years, lessening the immediate hit to the county's budget, the Times reported.
The county judges had warned that the courts would close in mid-May without additional funds and had threatened to sign an order forcing the county to make the appropriation.
